rejected_rule.statement: A property subjected to a deed containing a condition to re-transfer the same cannot be treated as a property holding in trust for another party.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: I do not see any wrong in the aforesaid findings of the learned District Judge which are being supported with authorities Therefore. I am not inclined to interfere with the decision of the learned District Judge. Learned District Judge having identified the said issue has stated that a property subjected to a deed containing a condition to re-transfer the same cannot be treated as a property holding in trust for another party.
